keyPoints.text: A change freeze on payroll rules runs from 1 December until the end of the second pay run.
keyPoints.quote: So we have a change freeze from the first of December until the end of the second pay run.

keyPoints.text: The vendor has signed off the upgrade package and the pay run calculations tested well.
keyPoints.quote: The vendor has signed off the upgrade package. Test results are good on the pay run calculations.

actions.text: Email all department heads about the freeze
actions.quote: I'll email them all by end of day tomorrow.
Give me this one, I'll do it.

actions.text: Test a restore of the payroll database from backup
actions.quote: I'll test a restore before the freeze and tell you what happens.
I'll send the board a summary next Friday.

risks.text: The test environment is on version 7 while production is on version 9, so testing was on the wrong version.
risks.quote: It's still on version 7. Production is on version 9.

risks.text: Nobody has tried restoring the payroll database from a backup.
risks.quote: Nobody has actually tried restoring the payroll database from last night's backup.

risks.text: Only Ibrahim knows the vendor's API, so his absence would block the upgrade.
risks.quote: if Ibrahim is off sick on the first of December, we are stuck.

traps.what: Colm offered to write the rollback plan then gave it to Freya.
Raising the test environment with the vendor was explicitly not made a task.
traps.quote: I won't make that an official task until we know the cost.

traps.what: Barrier, sandwiches and fire drill are small talk.
traps.quote: The fire drill is Tuesday, so nobody panic when the alarm goes.
